Vaishnavi Kapoor | vaishnavi.kapoor570@example.com | +91 9666818287
Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
Notice period: 60 days

Professional Summary
Data Engineer with hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines, transformations, and orchestration on cloud platforms. Proven track record delivering reliable ETL processes, improving data quality, and enabling analytics consumption using modern tooling and collaboration practices.

Technical Skills
Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, dbt, AWS, Kafka, Jira, Linux, Confluence

Work Experience
Data Engineer, Vertex Analytics (Nov 2025 - Present)
- Developed and maintained Apache Airflow DAGs to orchestrate daily and near-real-time ETL workflows, reducing pipeline failures by implementing retries and alerting using Jira for incident tracking.
- Implemented dbt models to standardize and document transformations in the analytics schema, improving downstream query performance and enabling reproducible data builds.
- Built AWS-based ingestion pipeline using S3, Lambda, and managed Kafka consumers to process streaming events; optimized SQL queries for aggregated marts used by analytics teams.
- Collaborated with stakeholders via Confluence to define data contracts and operational runbooks; used Linux-based tooling for pipeline deployments and monitoring.

Data Engineer, Razorpay (Oct 2024 - Oct 2025)
- Designed and optimized SQL-based ETL jobs for transaction datasets, improving aggregation latency for reporting dashboards and reducing cost on AWS compute resources.
- Implemented Python data processing scripts and Kafka consumers to handle event backfills and schema evolution; documented processes in Confluence and tracked work with Jira.
- Automated scheduling and monitoring of ETL pipelines using Apache Airflow, integrating alerts and remediation steps; maintained Linux-based environments for batch processing.
- Contributed dbt models and tests to enforce data quality, collaborated with analytics consumers to validate transformations.

Education
BBA, Christ University
